scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Welcome back! You look really tired. Are you okay?
scene.zh: 歡迎回來！你看起來好累，還好嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I've been getting headaches ever since I got back from London.
scene.zh: 從倫敦回來以後，我就一直頭痛。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's not good. Are you still suffering from jet lag?
scene.zh: 這樣不太妙。你時差還沒調過來嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I think I'm still tired from the long flight home.
scene.zh: 應該是回來那趟長途飛行還沒緩過來。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: All those hours on a plane are hard on your neck and shoulders.
scene.zh: 在飛機上坐那麼久，脖子和肩膀都會很難受。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: If the pain doesn't go away, go see a doctor.
scene.zh: 如果一直痠痛不會好，就去看個醫生。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And stay home if you feel ill. There's a virus going around.
scene.zh: 還有，不舒服就待在家。最近有病毒在傳。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Get some sleep this weekend. You need to stay healthy.
scene.zh: 這個週末好好睡一覺，身體要顧好。

fills.en: Is it okay to eat breakfast before the ___ test?
fills.zh: 抽血之前可以吃早餐嗎？

fills.en: Ms. Reed asked ___ I had any allergies.
fills.zh: Reed 小姐問我有沒有任何過敏。
fills.note: 轉述是非問句用 if（是否）。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi! Quick reminder: our yearly checkups are next month.
scene.zh: 嗨！提醒你一下，每年的健康檢查下個月就要做了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It's at the clinic on Main Street, and the company pays.
scene.zh: 在 Main Street 的診所，費用公司出。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Do I need to make an appointment for the checkup myself?
scene.zh: 健康檢查要我自己去預約嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, just call them. Please fill out this medical form, too.
scene.zh: 對，打電話給他們就好。這張醫療表格也請你填一下。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: If you have any severe allergies, write them on the form.
scene.zh: 如果你有嚴重的過敏，要寫在表格上。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Is it okay to eat breakfast before the blood test?
scene.zh: 抽血之前可以吃早餐嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: No, nothing after midnight. Water is okay.
scene.zh: 不行，半夜十二點以後什麼都不能吃。喝水可以。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The consultation with the physician is optional, but I'd go.
scene.zh: 跟醫師諮詢那部分可以自己選，不過我會去。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Tell her about those headaches and any other symptoms.
scene.zh: 把你頭痛的事和其他症狀都跟她說。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So you're eating in here today? That's new.
scene.zh: 你今天在這裡吃飯？真難得。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I used to eat lunch at my desk almost every day.
scene.zh: 我以前幾乎每天都在座位上吃午餐。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Me too, until my doctor asked me about my lifestyle.
scene.zh: 我以前也是，後來醫生問起我的生活方式。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: She said sitting all day is more harmful than people think.
scene.zh: 她說整天坐著，比大家想的還傷身。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So how are you sleeping these days? Any better?
scene.zh: 那你最近睡得怎麼樣？有好一點嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I never used to have trouble sleeping at night.
scene.zh: 我以前晚上從來不會睡不好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Regular hours help. Go to bed at the same time every night.
scene.zh: 作息規律會有幫助。每天晚上同一個時間上床。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And watch your diet. Smaller portions at dinner helped me a lot.
scene.zh: 飲食也要注意。我晚餐吃少一點以後，差很多。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It's tough the first week or two, but do it consistently and it works.
scene.zh: 頭一兩個禮拜會有點辛苦，不過持續做下去，真的有用。

texts.title: Your benefits for next year
lines: Good news: your benefits will be better next year. From January 1, we are moving to a more comprehensive health insurance plan. It will still be administered by the same insurance company.
There are two plans this time, Basic and Plus. Both include prescription medicine. Please see the attached table.
You may also insure your family members. This is voluntary. It costs $30 a month for each person, and it comes out of your pay.
Our pension and retirement plans will not change. Please note that the Plus plan is exclusively for employees who work full time.
Please return your form to me by September 30.

texts.title: Health Plans for Next Year
lines: Basic plan: The company pays the full cost. Coverage includes doctor visits, hospital care and prescription medicine.
Plus plan: You pay $40 a month. Coverage includes everything in the Basic plan, plus dental care and eye care.
Dental care and eye care are not part of the Basic plan.
You can change your plan once a year, in September.
Your total compensation includes your salary, insurance, pension and $300 a year to spend on healthcare.

questions.en: What is the email mainly about?
questions.zh: 這封 email 主要在說什麼？

questions.en: When should employees return the form?

questions.en: You want dental care and want to insure one family member. How much do you pay each month?

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi! Did you get my email about next year's benefits?
scene.zh: 嗨！你有收到我寄的明年福利 email 嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: We're moving to a more comprehensive health plan.
scene.zh: 我們要換成保障更完整的健康保險方案。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Prescription medicine is covered on both plans.
scene.zh: 兩種方案都有包含處方藥。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The Plus plan adds dental care, but you pay forty dollars a month.
scene.zh: Plus 方案多了牙科，不過每個月要自付四十美元。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: You can add family members, too. That part's voluntary.
scene.zh: 你也可以替家人加保，那部分是自由參加的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Have you had a chance to look at the two plans yet?
scene.zh: 兩種方案你有空看過了嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'll compare the two insurance plans this weekend and decide.
scene.zh: 我這個週末會比較一下兩種保險方案再決定。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sounds good. Just get the form back to me by September 30.
scene.zh: 好啊。只要在九月三十日前把表格交回給我就好。

lines.en: How many days of sick leave do we get each year?
lines.zh: 我們每年有幾天病假？

lines.en: Ten paid days. You can also use them when your spouse or children are ill.
lines.zh: 十天有薪假。配偶或小孩生病的時候也可以用。

lines.en: For a long illness or injury, you get partial pay for one month. After that, it's unpaid.
lines.zh: 如果是長期生病或受傷，第一個月領部分薪水，之後就是無薪。

lines.en: And you worked weekends in London, so you get two extra days off.
lines.zh: 還有，你在倫敦週末也在工作，所以多給你兩天假。

lines.en: Really? Thank you. I could use the rest.
lines.zh: 真的嗎？謝謝您，我正需要休息。

lines.en: There's also one mental health day a year. We keep a record of it separately.
lines.zh: 另外每年有一天心理健康假，我們會分開記。

lines.en: And our hotline is free if you ever need someone to talk to.
lines.zh: 如果你需要找人聊聊，我們也有免費的專線。

lines.en: We're also trying flextime this fall. It's good for morale.
lines.zh: 我們今年秋天也在試行彈性上班，對士氣有幫助。

lines.en: So with flextime, I could start at ten and leave at seven?
lines.zh: 所以彈性上班的話，我可以十點進來、七點走嗎？

lines.en: Yes, as long as you're here from ten to four.
lines.zh: 可以，只要十點到四點都在公司就好。

lines.en: And if you get hurt at work, the first aid supplies are in the break room.
lines.zh: 還有，如果在公司受傷，急救用品在茶水間。

scene.en: How many days of sick leave do we get each year?
scene.zh: 我們每年有幾天病假？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Ten paid days. After that, it's partial pay.

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Can I add something? We're also trying flextime this fall.
scene.zh: 我補充一下，我們今年秋天也在試行彈性上班。

textFills.title: Our New Wellness Program
lines: Staying active is beneficial for everyone, so we are starting a wellness program this month.
Yoga: Wednesdays at 6 p.m. Please ___ on the sheet in the break room.
Fitness: The company pays half of your gym membership, and the lockers are free.
Massage: Every other Friday. Enjoy fifteen minutes of ___.
zh: 保持活動對每個人都有好處，所以這個月起我們推出健康計畫。
瑜伽：每週三晚上六點。請在茶水間的表上報名。
健身：公司幫你付一半的健身房會費，置物櫃免費。
按摩：每隔一週的星期五。享受十五分鐘的放鬆。
休閒運動：加入我們星期六的健走團！

options: Your blood test is on Monday.
blanks.note: 休閒運動後面要接一個活動。

lines.en: Good afternoon. Many of you sit at a desk all day and check your phone in bed.
lines.zh: 大家午安。你們很多人整天坐在辦公桌前，躺在床上還在看手機。

lines.en: That's not good for your heart. And fatigue isn't only physical.
lines.zh: 這對心臟不好。而且疲勞不只是身體上的。

lines.en: Long hours and intense deadlines put a real burden on your body and your mood.
lines.zh: 長時間工作和很趕的期限，對身體和心情都是很大的負擔。

lines.en: Stress and anxiety don't go away by themselves. You need healthy ways to cope.
lines.zh: 壓力和焦慮不會自己消失，你需要用健康的方法來調適。

lines.en: Whether you are a commuter or work from home, here are three simple things.
lines.zh: 不管你是通勤族還是在家工作，這裡有三件簡單的事。

lines.en: First, stand up and walk around periodically. Set a timer for every hour.
lines.zh: 第一，每隔一段時間就站起來走一走。可以設個每小時響一次的計時器。

lines.en: Second, at night, leave your phone in another room.
lines.zh: 第二，晚上把手機放在別的房間。

lines.en: Third, you don't need to be athletic. A short walk after lunch really helps.
lines.zh: 第三，你不需要很會運動。午餐後散步一下就很有幫助。

lines.en: These steps relieve stress and help your emotional health.
lines.zh: 這些小事能減輕壓力，對情緒健康也有幫助。

lines.en: Make time for leisure. And no, you don't need supplements.
lines.zh: 要留點休閒時間。還有，你不需要靠營養補充品。

scene.en: I never used to have trouble sleeping at night.
scene.zh: 我以前晚上從來不會睡不好。

scene.speaker: npc

scene.zh: 說不定就是那些很晚的 email 害的，也會影響我的心情。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And my desk is a mess. Too many distractions.
scene.zh: 還有我的桌子亂七八糟，太多讓人分心的東西了。

scene.speaker: npc

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Who knew a lunch talk could be so useful?
scene.zh: 誰想得到一場午休講座這麼有用？

scene.speaker: npc

scene.zh: 我們這個禮拜都試一件新的事，看看效果怎麼樣。

scene.speaker: npc

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Would it be okay if I took next Friday off?
scene.zh: 我下週五請一天假可以嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Of course. Don't feel uncomfortable asking.
scene.zh: 當然可以。開口請假不用不好意思。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Your accuracy is usually great, but I've seen a few careless mistakes.
scene.zh: 你平常都很準確，不過我最近看到幾個粗心的錯。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Working weekends shouldn't be a regular occurrence. It's partially my fault.
scene.zh: 週末加班不該是常態，這有一部分是我的錯。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Thanks for your flexibility. You're always so considerate.
scene.zh: 謝謝你一直這麼配合，你總是很體貼。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'll make sure Leo knows what to do while I'm away.
scene.zh: 我會確認 Leo 知道我不在的時候要做什麼。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. A day off won't do any harm. Rest and recover.
scene.zh: 很好。休一天不會有什麼壞處，好好休息、恢復一下。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: There you are! So, what did you think of today's talk?
scene.zh: 原來你在這裡！你覺得今天的講座怎麼樣？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: That talk made me think about my own habits.
scene.zh: 那場講座讓我反省了一下自己的習慣。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Same here. How are you feeling since your trip?
scene.zh: 我也是。出差回來以後，你身體還好嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I've been getting headaches ever since I got back from London.
scene.zh: 從倫敦回來以後，我就一直頭痛。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then your checkup comes at a good time. It's next Tuesday.
scene.zh: 那健康檢查來得正是時候，就在下週二。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Do I need to make an appointment for the checkup myself?
scene.zh: 健康檢查要我自己去預約嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, but I can call the clinic for you if you're busy.
scene.zh: 對，不過你忙的話，我可以幫你打給診所。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And please take a real lunch break. Not at your desk.
scene.zh: 還有，午休請好好休息，別在座位上吃。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I used to eat lunch at my desk almost every day.
scene.zh: 我以前幾乎每天都在座位上吃午餐。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Used to? Good. Keep it that way.
scene.zh: 以前？很好，繼續保持。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Have you picked a health plan yet? The forms are due soon.
scene.zh: 你選好保險方案了嗎？表格快到期了。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'll compare the two insurance plans this weekend and decide.
scene.zh: 我這個週末會比較一下兩種保險方案再決定。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Mornings are hard after a long trip. Try the new flextime.
scene.zh: 長途出差回來早上很難起床，試試新的彈性上班吧。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: So with flextime, I could start at ten and leave at seven?
scene.zh: 所以彈性上班的話，我可以十點進來、七點走嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Exactly. Just be here between ten and four.
scene.zh: 沒錯，只要十點到四點之間在公司就好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And the yoga class still has a few spots left.
scene.zh: 還有，瑜伽課還剩幾個名額。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I just signed up for the yoga class on Wednesday evenings.
scene.zh: 我剛報名了週三晚上的瑜伽課。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great. Honestly, I think you need a real break, too.
scene.zh: 很好。說真的，我覺得你也需要好好放個假。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Would it be okay if I took next Friday off?
scene.zh: 我下週五請一天假可以嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Of course. Rest, recover, and come back refreshed.
scene.zh: 當然可以。好好休息、恢復體力，回來的時候精神會好一點。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'll make sure Leo knows what to do while I'm away.
scene.zh: 我會確認 Leo 知道我不在的時候要做什麼。
